description: Implementation of the SceneSet plugin class, managing application lifecycle, initialization, and restart logic within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: SceneSet
classes.description: A plugin class managing scene application lifecycle, startup, shutdown, and restart within the WPEFramework environment.

methods.name: SceneSet::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up app manager interface, and starts the reference app.

methods.name: SceneSet::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases interfaces.

methods.name: SceneSet::OnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle state change events.

methods.name: SceneSet::StartReferenceApp
methods.description: Launches the reference application via AppManager.

methods.name: SceneSet::MonitorReferenceAppCrash
methods.description: Placeholder for monitoring reference app crashes.

methods.name: SceneSet::RestartReferenceApp
methods.description: Restarts the reference app if it crashes.
